                             NOTICE OF RESULTS
                  PHOENIX HUMAN RELATIONS COMMISSION (PHRC)
                    MEET YOUR NEIGHBOR SUMMIT COMMITTEE
                              VIRTUAL MEETING

Pursuant to A.R.S. Section 38-431.02, notice is hereby given to the members of the
PHOENIX HUMAN RELATIONS COMMISSION – MEET YOUR NEIGHBOR SUMMIT
COMMITTEE and to the general public, that the PHOENIX HUMAN RELATIONS
COMMISSION – MEET YOUR NEIGHBOR SUMMIT COMMITTEE held a virtual meeting
open to the public on Wednesday, July 22, 2026, at 11:00 a.m.

The Phoenix Human Relations Commission – Meet Your Neighbor Summit Committee
meeting was held virtually; the public could listen to the meeting live via video conference.
For more information on the meeting format, please contact Shanna Archie at 602-534-1279
or shanna.archie@phoenix.gov.

Executive Sessions – Pursuant to A.R.S. Section 38-431.03. (A) (1), (2), (3) and (4), the
Commission may vote to convene in executive session as permitted by the Arizona Open
Meeting Law to discuss, consider matters listed on the agenda, or confidential records
exempt by law from public inspection, and/or to consult with the Commission Attorney for
legal advice and to consider the Commission’s position and to instruct the Commission
regarding any items on the agenda. The Executive Session will not be open to the public. The
Commission will take action in public session.

For more information on the meeting format, additional information, or to request reasonable
accommodations, please contact Shanna Archie, Equal Opportunity Specialist/Commission
Liaison at 602.534.1279 or TTY/602-534-1557 (or use 7-1-1).

Persons paid to lobby on behalf of persons or organizations other than themselves
shall register with the City Clerk prior to lobbying or within five business days
thereafter and must register annually to continue lobbying. If you have any questions
about registration or if you must register, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at 602-
262-6811.
